name: kubernetes-assessment-workbench
description: Reconcile an approved Kubernetes context with a sanitized local observation without cluster access.

interface.longDescription: Check a selected context, approved namespaces, identity anchor, and access limits in a sanitized local JSON export. Reports uncertainty without contacting a cluster or granting live execution.
